# uor-discord-read Specification

<!-- Generated by Prism from prism/spec.json. Change the app through your agent with /prism, not by editing this file. -->

## Purpose

Discord channel read policy: Permit the read-only collector to read a UOR Foundation Discord channel only when it is a text or forum channel everyone can view, the Foundation labels it public, a server administrator installed the bot and the Message Content intent is granted.

## Requirements

### Requirement: Never permit when kind is dm

The app SHALL NOT answer `permit` when kind is dm, because direct messages are never read.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-001, theorem `inv001Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-001 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `dm everyone public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `permit`
- **AND** the app answers `deny`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: Never permit when visibility is restricted

The app SHALL NOT answer `permit` when visibility is restricted, because a restricted channel is never read.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-002, theorem `inv002Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-002 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `text restricted public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `permit`
- **AND** the app answers `deny`, decided by REQ-004

### Requirement: Never permit when label is not public

The app SHALL NOT answer `permit` when label is not public, because only channels the Foundation labels public are read.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-003, theorem `inv003Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-003 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone excluded admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `permit`
- **AND** the app answers `deny`, decided by REQ-005

### Requirement: Never permit when install is other

The app SHALL NOT answer `permit` when install is other, because a bot not installed by a server administrator never reads.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-004, theorem `inv004Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-004 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public other granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `permit`
- **AND** the app answers `deny`, decided by REQ-003

### Requirement: Never permit when intent is missing

The app SHALL NOT answer `permit` when intent is missing, because empty content is never counted as a reading.

Verified: to be proved by Lean for every request (INV-005, theorem `inv005Holds`).

#### Scenario: INV-005 holds

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public admin missing` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL NOT be `permit`
- **AND** the app answers `indeterminate`, decided by REQ-007

### Requirement: REQ-001 deny when kind is dm

The app SHALL answer `deny` when kind is dm, because CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md: reports arrive by direct message and are handled with confidentiality.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule1`).

#### Scenario: REQ-001 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `dm everyone public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-001

### Requirement: REQ-002 deny when kind is voice

The app SHALL answer `deny` when kind is voice and no earlier rule matches, because CHAOSS Chat Platform Inclusivity counts messages and participants; the collector records no audio.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule2`).

#### Scenario: REQ-002 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `voice everyone public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-002

### Requirement: REQ-003 deny when install is other

The app SHALL answer `deny` when install is other and no earlier rule matches, because Discord OAuth2 bot authorization: adding a bot to a server requires the Manage Server permission.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule3`).

#### Scenario: REQ-003 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public other granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-003

### Requirement: REQ-004 deny when visibility is restricted

The app SHALL answer `deny` when visibility is restricted and no earlier rule matches, because CHAOSS Chat Platform Inclusivity measures public shared chat rooms; a channel @everyone cannot view is not public.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule4`).

#### Scenario: REQ-004 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `text restricted public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-004

### Requirement: REQ-005 deny when label is excluded

The app SHALL answer `deny` when label is excluded and no earlier rule matches, because afflom/me: no personal data leaves its owner without declassification; the Foundation excludes the channel.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule5`).

#### Scenario: REQ-005 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone excluded admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-005

### Requirement: REQ-006 not-applicable when label is unlabeled

The app SHALL answer `not-applicable` when label is unlabeled and no earlier rule matches, because collection is opt-in per channel; an unlabeled channel is outside the policy.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule6`).

#### Scenario: REQ-006 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone unlabeled admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `not-applicable`, decided by REQ-006

### Requirement: REQ-007 indeterminate when intent is missing

The app SHALL answer `indeterminate` when intent is missing and no earlier rule matches, because Discord Gateway: without the Message Content privileged intent, message content fields arrive empty.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors (`rule7`).

#### Scenario: REQ-007 decides

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public admin missing` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `indeterminate`, decided by REQ-007

### Requirement: Otherwise permit

The app SHALL answer `permit` when no rule matches, because a public, labeled text or forum channel, with an admin-installed bot holding the Message Content intent.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

#### Scenario: No rule matches

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public admin granted` (an acceptance example)
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `permit`

### Requirement: The first matching rule decides

The app SHALL try REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007 in that order, and the first rule that matches SHALL decide.

Verified: tested by the acceptance vectors.

#### Scenario: Two rules match

- **WHEN** the request is `text everyone public other missing`
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `deny`, decided by REQ-003, the earlier rule

### Requirement: Request and answers

The app SHALL read one request as one line of 5 fields separated by single spaces, in this order, and SHALL answer exactly one of `permit`, `deny`, `not-applicable`, `indeterminate`, or `invalid` for anything else.

| Field | Accepts | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `text`, `forum`, `voice`, `dm` | the Discord channel type |
| `visibility` | `everyone`, `restricted` | whether the @everyone role can view the channel |
| `label` | `public`, `unlabeled`, `excluded` | how the Foundation labels the channel for collection |
| `install` | `admin`, `other` | whether the bot was authorized by a member with Manage Server |
| `intent` | `granted`, `missing` | whether the Message Content privileged intent is granted to the bot |

| Answer | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `permit` | the collector may read the channel's messages |
| `deny` | the collector must not read the channel |
| `not-applicable` | the Foundation has not labeled the channel, so nothing is collected |
| `indeterminate` | message content would arrive empty, so no reading can be trusted |
| `invalid` | the request is malformed |

Verified: reading a request is tested, not proved.

#### Scenario: A malformed request is invalid

- **WHEN** the request is not 5 fields in this order
- **THEN** the answer SHALL be `invalid`

## Examples

- `text everyone public admin granted` gives `permit`
- `forum everyone public admin granted` gives `permit`
- `dm everyone public admin granted` gives `deny`
- `voice everyone public admin granted` gives `deny`
- `text restricted public admin granted` gives `deny`
- `text everyone excluded admin granted` gives `deny`
- `text everyone unlabeled admin granted` gives `not-applicable`
- `text everyone public other granted` gives `deny`
- `text everyone public admin missing` gives `indeterminate`

## What is proved and what is tested

Lean proves each property marked proved above, for every request that decodes, with no exceptions and no sampling. The proof is about `judge`, the function the WebAssembly guest runs, because both come from the same model.

The parsing of requests is tested, not proved: the acceptance vectors in the app replay through the built guest, including malformed and oversized requests.

Nothing here says the rules are the right rules. That is the part only you can judge.
